name: The embrace
idea: Two figures become a single sheltering shape. Connection through care, with a smile in the space between.

name: Face to face
idea: Two sculpted profiles face one another. A quieter, more adult interpretation of meeting.

name: A helping hand
idea: A pair of open hands creates a heart. A more personal expression of reassurance and support.

idea: Two speech bubbles overlap. The service starts with listening and an introduction.
